summary: Recognize the exact string form of a Number used by integer-indexed exotic objects, with a special '-0' case.

semantics.otherwise: n = ToNumber(s); succeeds only if ToString(n) exactly equals s

caveats: '1.0' is not canonical even though it numerically equals 1.
'NaN' and 'Infinity' are canonical numeric index strings because they round-trip through ToNumber/ToString.
references: ECMAScript Language Specification, Type Conversion abstract operations (living specification)
